correctness.rationale: Explicit macroblocks and four exact macrotype counts reduce all lex rotation prefix classes to sixty-four local cases and four ordered exceptions. Long lookahead proves three cases, a shorter-word induction proves the fourth, then the full formula and \(4k-4\) count. The standalone checker independently tests complete finite instances through rank 14, but infinity follows from proof, not the checker. Primitive odd Hamming weight excludes tied rotations.
